title: Status Page Component Mapping (internal services/alerts → public components)
content:
Purpose
- Working sheet to map internal services + alert signals to the new customer-facing status page components.
- Used by: oncall (component selection), incident-bot draft-sync, and dashboards (“incidents by status component”).

Confidence scale
- High: 1:1 mapping; alert signal is specific; minimal chance of misleading customers.
- Medium: usually correct, but depends on route/model/region labeling or common coupling.
- Low: ambiguous signal or shared dependency; needs better instrumentation or runbook guidance.

Notes / conventions
- Public component naming (current draft):
  - Hosted API: API Gateway, Chat/Completions Serving, Streaming, Embeddings, Rerank, Capacity & Routing, Model Catalog & Versioning
  - Console: Console Web, Console API
  - Dedicated: Dedicated Control Plane, Dedicated Serving (by region)
  - Private: Private Control Plane, Private Serving
  - Cross-cutting: Auth & Billing (customer-facing auth failures), Observability/Logs (generally NOT public unless Console feature)
- Region scoping rule of thumb:
  - If metric has reliable region label and impact is isolated: choose “(Region) Hosted Serving” + the feature component (e.g., Streaming).
  - If router is spilling/failing across regions or global dependency: choose global component(s).
- Disclosure rule (reminder): do not map internal provider outages directly to provider name on status page; map to the customer-visible capability impacted.

Sheet (table)
Columns: Internal service/area | Primary alert signal | Customer symptom(s) | Typical scope | Proposed public component(s) | Mapping guidance / notes | Confidence | Owner | Last reviewed

1) edge-gateway (api-gw) | api_gw_5xx_rate>1% 5m | 5xx on all API routes; elevated retries | global or region | API Gateway | Use when failures occur before request reaches router/serving (no model-specific correlation) | High | Amara Diallo | 2024-07-01
2) edge-gateway (api-gw) | api_gw_p99_latency>2s 10m | Slow requests across endpoints | global or region | API Gateway | If latency is dominated by TLS/WAF/rate-limit checks; confirm upstream latency not primary | Medium | Amara Diallo | 2024-07-01
3) auth-service | auth_fail_rate (401/403) spike | Authentication errors; token rejected | global | API Gateway (or “Auth & Billing” if we add) | If it’s genuinely auth validation, select API Gateway + include workaround text (rotate keys) | Medium | Ethan Park | 2024-06-28
4) quota-service | 429_rate_above_baseline | Unexpected 429s for in-quota customers | global | Capacity & Routing | Use when policy/rate limiter is misbehaving (not true capacity exhaustion) | Medium | Mina Haddad | 2024-06-27
5) rate-limit-config (control plane) | rl_config_push_errors | Bursty 429s after config rollout | global | Capacity & Routing | Pair with comms: “some requests rate-limited unexpectedly”; avoid saying “config bug” publicly | Medium | Mina Haddad | 2024-06-27
6) inference-router | router_no_capacity_events | 503/429 w/ “no capacity”; increased queueing | region-heavy | Capacity & Routing + (Region) Chat/Completions Serving | If tied to one region, mark region serving; if cross-region spillover, mark global Capacity & Routing too | High | Mina Haddad | 2024-07-02
7) inference-router | router_misroute_rate | Requests routed to incompatible backend; 5xx | global | Capacity & Routing | Requires structured incident annotation (see pr_48219); otherwise often ambiguous | Low | Mina Haddad | 2024-06-26
8) scheduler (gpu-scheduler) | scheduling_latency_p99 | Increased queue time; slow TTFT | region | Capacity & Routing + (Region) Chat/Completions Serving | Prefer “Capacity & Routing” when customers primarily see timeouts/slow start before token stream begins | Medium | Mina Haddad | 2024-07-02
9) batcher (continuous batching) | batcher_backlog_depth | Elevated latency under load | region | (Region) Chat/Completions Serving | Only use if request reaches serving and backlog is on model workers; otherwise Capacity & Routing | Medium | Christine Wong | 2024-06-25
10) kv-cache subsystem | kv_cache_evictions_rate | Higher latency; increased compute cost; occasional timeouts | region | (Region) Chat/Completions Serving | Customer impact is typically “degraded performance” not outright outage | Medium | Christine Wong | 2024-06-25
11) runtime (streaming stack) | streaming_disconnect_rate | Streams cut off; client sees incomplete outputs | region | Streaming | Classic driver for taxonomy change (SUP-18421); do NOT mark entire API as down unless non-streaming also fails | High | Christine Wong | 2024-07-01
12) runtime (streaming stack) | sse_keepalive_timeouts | Streams stall; reconnect loops | region | Streaming | This was recurring; include customer guidance: “retry with backoff; consider non-streaming temporarily” | High | Tomáš Novák | 2024-06-30
13) websocket-bridge (if enabled) | ws_upgrade_failures | Websocket clients fail to connect | region | Streaming | Only impacts some SDK modes; if unsure, mark Streaming degraded (partial) | Medium | Christine Wong | 2024-06-24
14) chat-serving (text generation) | serving_5xx_rate_by_route(chat) | Chat/completions requests error; embeddings OK | region | (Region) Chat/Completions Serving | Use route label added in pr_48244; if missing labels, fall back to global Chat/Completions Serving | High | Christine Wong | 2024-07-02
15) chat-serving (text generation) | serving_p99_latency_by_route(chat) | Slow responses; TTFT elevated | region | (Region) Chat/Completions Serving | If streaming is fine but overall generation slow, do not mark Streaming | High | Christine Wong | 2024-07-02
16) embeddings-serving | embeddings_5xx_rate | Embeddings endpoint errors; chat OK | region | Embeddings | Straightforward; include mitigation if fallback model/region available | High | Christine Wong | 2024-06-29
17) embeddings-serving | embeddings_p99_latency | Slow embeddings; timeouts under load | region | Embeddings | Often capacity-related; if router shows no-capacity, include Capacity & Routing too | Medium | Mina Haddad | 2024-06-29
18) rerank-serving | rerank_5xx_rate | Rerank endpoint errors | region | Rerank | Ensure customers know scope: only rerank; other endpoints unaffected | High | Christine Wong | 2024-06-29
19) model-catalog service | model_list_errors | Model listing fails; cannot discover models | global | Model Catalog & Versioning | Impacts Console + API list endpoints; may also affect deployments/rollouts | Medium | Ethan Park | 2024-06-23
20) model-registry (version pinning) | model_version_resolution_failures | Requests fail on pinned version; fallback fails | global | Model Catalog & Versioning + Chat/Completions Serving | Mark both if live traffic failing; if only listing/pinning impacted, just Catalog | Medium | Ethan Park | 2024-06-23
21) canary/rollouts controller | rollout_controller_errors | Rollouts stuck; canary not progressing | global | Console API (or Model Catalog & Versioning) | Customer-facing impact is operational; only mark if it blocks production usage (not just UI) | Low | Marissa Cole | 2024-06-20
22) console-web (frontend) | console_frontend_5xx | Console UI won’t load | global | Console Web | Don’t conflate with API serving. Customers may still send traffic via API/SDK | High | Nora Ahmed | 2024-06-28
23) console-api | console_api_5xx | Console dashboards/actions fail; API serving OK | global | Console API | Include mitigation: “API remains available; console actions may fail” | High | Nora Ahmed | 2024-06-28
24) usage/billing pipeline | usage_events_backlog | Delayed usage visibility; metering lag | global | Console API | Usually not incident-worthy unless it breaks auth/quota enforcement | Low | Allison Grant | 2024-06-18
25) incident annotations emitter | incident_annotation_drop_rate | Missing component labels; comms tooling degraded | global | (Internal only; no public component) | Track internally; impacts our ability to communicate, but not customer functionality | High | Aisha Bello | 2024-06-21
26) dedicated-control-plane (provisioning) | dedicated_cp_provision_failures | New dedicated capacity changes fail | per customer / region | Dedicated Control Plane | If only one tenant impacted, avoid broad status post; use if multi-tenant/systemic | Medium | Dylan Brooks | 2024-06-26
27) dedicated-control-plane (authz) | dedicated_cp_authz_errors | Dedicated console/API actions denied | per customer / global | Dedicated Control Plane | Similar to above; may be single-tenant. Confirm blast radius | Low | Dylan Brooks | 2024-06-26
28) dedicated-serving workers | dedicated_serving_5xx | Dedicated inference errors | per region | Dedicated Serving (Region) | Include region and (if safe) “Dedicated only” to avoid confusing Hosted API customers | High | Christine Wong | 2024-06-27
29) private-control-plane | private_cp_sync_failures | Customer private control plane can’t sync configs | per deployment | Private Control Plane | Usually customer-specific; publish only if multi-customer or platform-wide regression | Low | Sara Al-Masri | 2024-06-22
30) private-serving runtime | private_serving_healthcheck_fail | Private deployments failing health checks post-upgrade | per deployment / region | Private Serving | Often release-related; comms typically direct to affected customers unless widespread | Low | Sara Al-Masri | 2024-06-22
31) region networking (ingress) | region_ingress_packet_loss | Elevated timeouts; random disconnects | single region | (Region) API Gateway + Streaming (if disconnect-driven) | If the symptom is “disconnects,” add Streaming. If it’s “timeouts before response,” add API Gateway | Medium | Allison Grant | 2024-06-24
32) datastore dependency (model metadata) | metadata_store_latency | Slow model resolution; sporadic 5xx | global | Model Catalog & Versioning | Avoid public mention of datastore; describe as “model metadata lookups degraded” if needed | Medium | Ethan Park | 2024-06-23
33) tokenization service | tokenizer_errors | 4xx/5xx on input parsing; requests rejected | global | Chat/Completions Serving | Verify this is server-side not invalid user input. If it’s a regression, mark degraded | Low | Christine Wong | 2024-06-19
34) safety/filters (if enabled) | safety_check_timeouts | Requests hang before first token; elevated latency | global | Chat/Completions Serving | If safety gating is part of the pipeline. Confirm it’s not customer prompt-related | Low | Rafael Mendes | 2024-06-20
35) image/model artifact fetcher | artifact_fetch_failures | Cold starts; sporadic 5xx on rare models | region | Model Catalog & Versioning + (Region) Chat/Completions Serving | If only a model family impacted, include that in incident update text (don’t over-broaden components) | Medium | Ethan Park | 2024-06-25
36) fallback policy engine | fallback_failures | Errors spike when primary backend degraded; no fallback engaged | global | Capacity & Routing | Customer-facing symptom: “automatic fallback not functioning”; treat as Sev1 if it increases outage scope | Medium | Mina Haddad | 2024-07-02

Open gaps / TODOs (for instrumentation + mapping quality)
- Add/verify route + region labels for: streaming_disconnect_rate, serving_5xx_rate_by_route, router_no_capacity_events (tracked in GitHub:redwood/pr_48244 + follow-ups).
- Decide whether to introduce a public “Auth & Billing” component vs keeping under API Gateway (pending taxonomy decision; see Slack debate around customer confusion).
- Add model-family labels for incidents where only a model series is affected (e.g., “mistral-*” vs “llama-*”) without exposing internal clusters.
- Validate Dedicated/Private blast radius detection so we don’t post broad incidents for single-tenant issues.

Change log (manual)
- 2024-07-02: Updated router + serving rows to assume region/route labels are available; marked a few previously Low → Medium.
- 2024-07-01: Clarified “Streaming vs API Gateway” mapping rule (disconnects vs pre-response timeouts).
